The film tells the story of how two accounting students from Trinity College in San Antonio found solidarity in their weirdness, recruited like-minded misfits – queers, weirdos, and nonconformists like naked performance artist/dancer Kathleen Lynch – and embarked on one of the most radical rock journeys of all time. movies.title: Film Comment Live: Play Me Something
movies.description: In 1989, John Berger collaborated with Scottish director Timothy Neat to make a film out of “Play Me Something,” his short story first published in The Three Penny Review in 1985, and later included as the final chapter of Berger’s short-story collection, Once in Europa (1987). Set in a small airport on the Scottish island of Barra, where planes land on a tidal beach, Play Me Something draws on Celtic oral tradition and European modernism to tell the beguiling story of a storyteller: a mysterious raconteur played by Berger in a bowler hat. He appears as a motley band of passengers waits for a delayed plane and begins to narrate his tale of an Italian farmer and an urbane young woman who meet at a Communist festival on the Venetian island of Giudecca. As Berger recounts the story, we see it unfold in bits of 16mm color and black-and-white footage, scenes on a television, and still photographs by Jean Mohr. The gaps are filled in by the audience of enraptured passengers—including a young Tilda Swinton and Scottish philosopher Hamish Henderson—so that the nonplace of the airport becomes a site of collective conjuring. Part of Hold Everything Dear—John Berger and Cinema , a multi-venue Film Comment series celebrating Berger’s centennial.

On August 8th & 10th, join Dead Heads in your neighborhood – and around the world – for the 2026 Grateful Dead Meet-Up at the Movies. This can't-miss event features the complete June 17, 1991, concert from Giants Stadium.
The performance launches with a shocking "Eyes Of The World," finding the band in peak form from the very first notes. The setlist continues, seamlessly blending beloved classics like "Truckin'" and "Uncle John's Band" with rarities such as "Saint of Circumstance," "Might As Well," "New Speedway Boogie," and "China Doll." The major highlight of the night is the continuous teases of "Dark Star" edging its way in and out through the evening at six different points before finally exploding into the full song. The Dead capped off the spectacular night with The Band's "The Weight," a perfect song to send the crowd on its way.
Considered one of the greatest shows of the band's final decade of performing, 6/17/91 offers a unique auditory experience as one of only two shows captured on 48-track tape. Enjoy a masterful surround sound mix by Jeffrey Norman and multi-camera visuals, featuring a rare cinematic appearance by both Bruce Hornsby and Vince Welnick.
As a bonus, this extraordinary screening will also feature an exclusive sneak preview of the legendary "Shakedown Street" from the upcoming Merriweather 6/30/85 release, and a special introduction by Grateful Dead legacy manager and audio archivist David Lemieux.

movies.description:
“A remarkable portrait of pop-culture obsession – how it can unite us, change us, and ripple down through our entire lives in ways both uplifting and unsettling.” – Matthew Jackson, AV Club
Have you ever lost yourself so deeply into a TV show that it became a core part of your identity? Then you’ll find some kindred souls in the two disaffected suburban kids at the center of Jane Schoenbrun’s brilliant I SAW THE TV GLOW from A24. Our story follows two lonely outsiders, Owen (Justice Smith) and Maddy (Brigette Lundy-Paine), as they find connection through their mutual love of an obscure late-night TV show, The Pink Opaque. As the static of the TV screen begins to warp their perception of reality, they start to realize that their obsession might not be the innocent escape they thought it was.
I SAW THE TV GLOW is pure, weapons-grade nostalgia for anyone who grew up staring into a fuzzy CRT TV way past their bedtime. The genius of it though is that it doesn’t pander, rather using our nostalgia to make us rethink our connection to the lost obsessions of our youth and how they define who we are today. It’s a remarkable follow-up to WE’RE ALL GOING TO THE WORLD’S FAIR from writer/director Jane Schoenbrun that will make you want to pop it back in the VHS player for another rewatch. It’s also got one of the most killer soundtracks in years, utilizing original tracks from artists like yeule, Sloppy Jane, and King Woman in clever ways that complement and elevate the scenes they’re in beautifully.

movies.director: Kent Jones Starring Willem Dafoe, Greta Lee, And Edmund Donovan
movies.description: Willem Dafoe is Ed Saxberger, a postal worker whose former life as a downtown poet in late-70s New York is rediscovered by a young admirer (Donovan) and his “Enthusiasm Society,” a group of 20-somethings with a comically romanticized sense of the past. In the company of his new friends, including the mysterious and mercurial Gloria (Lee of PAST LIVES), Ed has the uncanny feeling of merging with his younger self. Directed by Kent Jones (DIANE) from a witty, razor-sharp script by Samy Burch (MAY D

movies.title: Learning To Fly
movies.cast: Aisha McAdams, Eszter Csillag, Jim Walmsley
movies.description:
Under a full moon over the Alps, a headlamp bobs through the dark for the eighteenth hour. This is ultra running: 100 miles of mountain terrain, run through the night, chasing something just past the edge of what seems humanly possible.

LEARNING TO FLY follows Aisha McAdams - a photographer, and once a competitive runner herself - as she embeds with the sport's biggest names, including Jim Walmsley and Eszter Csillag, at the legendary Western States Endurance Run and the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. Her lens captures the 2 a.m. camaraderie, heartbreaking losses, and euphoric finishes.

But the closer Aisha gets to these athletes, the closer she gets to the runner she left behind, and the reasons she walked away from a sport that once gave her everything. Watching this community chase the impossible, Aisha is forced to ask whether she still has it in her to fly.

movies.title: Little Shop of Horrors (1986)
movies.description:
"Feed me, Seymour! Feed me all night long."
A singing plant. A daring hero. A sweet girl. A demented dentist. And one of the most outrageously fun movies ever made.
Rick Moranis is mild-mannered Seymour Krelborn, a down-on-his-luck employee at a plant shop in skid row who’s in love with Audrey (Ellen Greene), the unlucky-in-love girlfriend of the most sadistic dentist in town. But everything changes when Seymour finds a strange and unusual new plant that will only grow if given a different sort of plant food – people!
As the Audrey II gets bigger and bigger, Seymour finally realizes that he needs to stop it before it can take over the world, but can he destroy the alien plant and get the girl?

movies.title: Mac and Me
movies.cast: Christine Ebersole, Jonathan Ward, Katrina Caspary, Lauren Stanley, Jade Calegory

movies.title: Marcel the Shell with Shoes On
movies.description:
“By the film's end, it feels like the cinematic equivalent of a hug.” - Monica Castillo, TheWrap
There’s something magical about how easily you fall head over heels for a soft-voiced little shell in this sweet, funny, and full-hearted film from co-creators Dean Fleischer-Camp and Jenny Slate. The character is pretty self-explanatory: Marcel (voiced by Slate) is a shell with shoes on. He inhabits a home in California with his grandmother, Connie (voiced with astounding sincerity by Isabella Rossellini), and befriends a documentary filmmaker (Dean Fleischer-Camp, presumably with shoes on) who’s renting the house from its human owners. What follows is an inventive, heart-warming, and whimsical story about growing up and finding your place in the world.
MARCEL THE SHELL WITH SHOES ON is the full-length followup to the massively popular short films of the same name animated with adorable stop motion. Everyone on the sparse cast is fantastic, but Isabella Rossellini steals the show with a breathtaking vocal performance packed with pathos, wisdom, and tenderness that feels like your grandma wrapping you in a warm blanket after a cold day. Fun, funny, and perfectly sweet while still touching on themes of loneliness and depression, Marcel’s quest to find his family is guaranteed to put a smile on your face.

movies.title: Memoria
movies.description: Startled at daybreak by an inexplicable loud bang of unknown origin while visiting her sister in Colombia, Scottish botanist Jessica (Tilda Swinton) sets out to discover the source of the sound, leading to encounters with doctors, audio engineers, and archaeologists uncovering ancient human remains at a construction site. The first international production and English-language feature by Thai auteur Apichatpong Weerasethakul ( Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives , Cemetery of Splendour ), Memoria is not only a bold, audacious film, but also a ringing endorsement of watching films on large screens in darkened rooms among other viewers—the only way Weerasethakul intends for this feature to be experienced.

movies.title: Michael Mann's Manhunter: The Final Cut
movies.cast: William Petersen, Tom Noonan, Joan Allen, Brian Cox
movies.description:
A retired criminal profiler (William Petersen) reluctantly returns to the FBI to help track down a serial killer of families and is forced to consult an expert – the imprisoned Dr. Hannibal Lecktor (Brian Cox in a subtly chilling performance). The third feature written and directed by Michael Mann is a gripping adaptation of the first of Thomas Harris' four novels featuring the iconic murderer Lecktor, and benefits from the filmmaker's typically striking visuals as well as a top-notch supporting cast, including Tom Noonan as the hunted killer and three-time Oscar nominee Joan Allen as his blind love interest.
This new 4K final cut, overseen by Mann, enhances the film’s depth, visual clarity and sound, offering audiences the ultimate immersive version. Shot in 1985, MANHUNTER was on a frontier in both its subject matter and film form, initiating an impressive list of subsequent films and series. (Rialto)

movies.title: Mikey and Nicky
movies.description: Nick is desperate, holed up in a cheap hotel, suffering from an ulcer and convinced that a local mobster wants him killed. He calls Mikey, his friend since childhood, but when Mikey arrives, Nick won't let him in; his moods swing. So begins a long night as Mike tries to take care of Nick, calm him down, and get him out of town. Their sojourn – on foot and on a city bus – takes them to a bar, a club, toward a movie theater, to the cemetery where Nick's mom is buried, and to Nick's girlfriend's apartment. Tempers fray and the friendship is tested. Meanwhile, a hit man who's getting information from someone is indeed looking for Nick.

movies.title: Moonrise Kingdom
movies.description:
An ode to young lovers from that patriarch of elegant quirk, Wes Anderson.
Set on a picturesque New England island in a Kodachrome summer of ’65, MOONRISE KINGDOM tells the story of Suzy and Sam, two troubled 12-year-olds who fall in love, make a secret pact, and run away together into the wilderness. As parents, authorities, and an entire Khaki Scout Troop mobilize to find them, a violent storm is brewing off-shore – and the peaceful island community is turned upside down in every which way.
Starring Anderson troupe regulars Bill Murray and Jason Schwartzman, along with heavy-hitters like Frances McDormand, Bruce Willis, Edward Norton, Tilda Swinton, and Harvey Keitel (plus the always welcome Bob Balaban), MOONRISE KINGDOM is a charm-saturated ‘60s romp awash in Anderson’s unconventional style.

movies.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
movies.description: Godzilla faces off against the benevolent insect monster-god Mothra in this clash of the titans, a crossover battle between two of Toho Studios’ most popular monsters – the last in which Godzilla would figure as a malevolent villain rather than a fearsome hero. MOTHRA VS. GODZILLA marks a creative high point in the Godzilla series, with pointed social commentary from director Ishiro Honda, a masterful score by Akira Ifukube, and astonishing special effects work by Eiji Tsuburaya.

movies.title: Mysterious Skin
movies.cast: Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brady Crobet, Michelle Trachtenberg, Elisabeth Shue

movies.title: Mysterious Skin (4K Restoration)
movies.description: At the age of eight, Kansas youngsters Neil and Brian played on the same little league baseball team. Now, ten years later, the two boys couldn't be more different. Neil is a charismatic but emotionally aloof male hustler, while Brian is a nervous introvert obsessed with the idea that he has been abducted by a UFO. When the boy's parallel lives inevitably intersect, the pair unearth dark, repressed secrets on a harrowing and unforgettable journey of self-discovery.

movies.title: Mystery Machine (7/27/2026)
movies.description: Shrouded in secrecy! Encircled by intrigue! The Mystery Machine promises to deliver cinematic treasures that span genres, countries, and tastes... only for those brave enough to enter. All shall be revealed only after the credits begin. Screening on select Mondays with discounted admission.

movies.title: Mystery Transmission
movies.description: Imagine that a local cable station was invaded by otherdimensional creatures at the stroke of midnight. That's Video Vortex. Each month, this series presents a mystery transmission that's culled from the outer limits of home video history – from essential underground films to surreal docs, from tokusatsu battle-parties to outsider experiments. So warm up the cathode tubes, dim the lights, and let your senses intermingle with the glow.

movies.title: Never After Dark
movies.cast: Moeka Hoshi, Kurumi Inagaki, Kento Kaku
movies.description: A wandering medium, Airi spends her life guiding restless spirits out of the world of the living. Summoned to an isolated country house, she comes face to face with a grotesque apparition with powers that defy Airi's experience. As she digs deeper into the house's past, a secret comes to light -- and Airi finds herself hunted by a far more unpredictable force. For the first time, her greatest adversary is not the supernatural, but the living.Content expanded.

movies.title: Nightborn
movies.cast: Seidi Haarla, Rupert Grint

movies.title: Nostalghia
movies.description: Andrei Tarkovsky explained that in Russian the word nostalghia conveys “the love for your homeland and the melancholy that arises from being far away.” This debilitating form of homesickness is embodied in his film about Russian intellectual Andrei Gorchakov doing research in Italy, who becomes obsessed with the Botticelli-like beauty of his translator Eugenia, as well as with the apocalyptic ramblings of a self-destructive wanderer named Domenico. Written with frequent Michelangelo Antonioni collaborator Tonino Guerra ( L’Avventura ), this mystical and mysterious collision of East and West incorporates an unnamed German Shepherd in a small role—a quiet nod to Tarkovsky's own pup and broader love of dogs.

movies.title: Off The Pig + Black Panthers
movies.description: Shown in celebration of the 60th anniversary of the Black Panther Party’s founding, these two shorts—one by acclaimed French New Wave auteur Agnés Varda and the other from the Newsreel collective—offer an opportunity to hear directly from Huey P. Newton, Eldridge Cleaver, and other Black Panthers during a pivotal moment for the organization. Followed by a panel discussion Off the Pig (Newsreel #19) (1968) Dir. San Francisco Newsreel With Eldridge Cleaver, Huey P. Newton, Bobby Seale 14min Comprised of interviews with Black Panther Party Minister of Defense Huey P. Newton and Minister of Information Eldridge Cleaver, footage of demonstrations, and drawings from Emory Douglas, this documentary from the nonprofit San Francisco Newsreel serves as a compelling portrait of the party’s leadership in 1967. Black Panthers (1968) Dir. Agnès Varda With Huey P. Newton, Eldridge Cleaver, Bobby Seale, Kwame Ture 28min, DCP In the summer of 1968, master of the French New Wave Agnés Varda turned her camera to Oakland, California to document meetings organized by the Black Panther Party in an effort to free founder Huey P. Newton.

movies.title: On The Silver Globe
movies.description: After abandoning a dystopian future Earth, a small band of dissident astronauts crash-land on an earthlike planet and set out to establish a new human civilization—only to discover in time that they carry the seeds of their own slow demise and a new mythology. Polish writer-director Andrzej Żuławski adapted On the Silver Globe from The Lunar Trilogy , novels written between 1901 and 1911 by his grand-uncle, Jerzy Żuławski. After a year of filming in 1976 and 1977, Polish authorities shut down the production and ordered all materials destroyed, but the studio, cast, and crew preserved reels, costumes, and props, allowing Żuławski to devise a conclusion in time to screen the film at Cannes in 1988. RogerEbert.com proclaimed, “Even out of time, even incomplete, even now that its director is gone for good, On the Silver Globe endures and its beautiful power will never dim.”

movies.title: Onda Nova
movies.cast: Carla Camurati, Cristina Mutarelli, Tânia Alves, Regina Casé

movies.title: One Flew Over The Cuckoo'S Nest
movies.cast: Jack Nicholson, Louise Fletcher, William Redfield, Brad Dourif
movies.description: A family of four are suddenly sealed inside their home with no way out, and must work together to survive against both their dwindling resources and the mysterious, looming threat that is keeping them trapped.

movies.title: One Night Only
movies.cast: Callum Turner, Monica Barbaro, Molly Ringwald, Maya Hawke, Julia Fox, Michelle Hurd, LeVar Burton

movies.title: Onslaught
movies.cast: Adria Arjona, Dan Stevens, Eric Wareheim, Reginald VelJohnson, Michael Biehn, Alex Pereira, Drew Starkey, Rebecca Hall

movies.title: Paddington 2
movies.description: The much-anticipated sequel to the worldwide hit family film finds Paddington happily settled with the Brown family in Windsor Gardens, where he has become a popular member of the community, spreading joy and marmalade wherever he goes. While searching for the perfect present for his beloved Aunt Lucy’s hundredth birthday, Paddington spots a unique pop-up book in Mr. Gruber’s antique shop, and embarks upon a series of odd jobs to buy it. But when the book is stolen, it’s up to Paddington and the Browns to unmask the thief…

movies.title: Paper Tiger In 35Mm
movies.cast: Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson, Miles Teller
movies.description: In James Gray's deeply felt and intense drama, two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

movies.title: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
movies.description: After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

movies.title: Phantom of the Paradise
movies.description:
The ultimate synthesis of horror and rock 'n' roll, Brian De Palma's PHANTOM OF THE PARADISE is an explosion of music, madness, and the director's trademark camera style, complete with prowling cameras and split screens. William Finley stars as Winslow Leach, an aspiring songwriter who is betrayed by Mephistophelean record mogul Swan (Paul Williams, who also wrote the Oscar-nominated song score). His scarred face covered with a silver mask, Leach sets out to avenge himself upon Swan and reclaim his music. Co-starring SUSPIRIA's Jessica Harper as Phoenix, the singer who catches both Leach and Swan's eye, and Gerrit Graham in a hilarious performance as over-the-top glam rock singer "Beef," PHANTOM OF THE PARADISE didn't find success upon initial release, but has since won legions of fans. Whether you're one of them or a newbie who has never experienced it before, come see PHANTOM in all its colorful, big-screen glory! (Tommy Swenson)
DCP courtesy of 20th Century and Walt Disney Pictures

movies.title: Practical Magic 2
movies.cast: Cassie Bradley, Nicole Kidman, Sandra Bullock, Lee Pace, Joey King, Maisie Williams, Dianne Wiest, Stockard Channing

movies.title: Pure Scum
movies.description: Two recently graduated private schoolboys are involved in a serious car accident after a party and flee into the city to escape the consequences of their actions. Knowing they will eventually be caught, they decide to bury their troubles in hedonistic pursuits of alcohol, drugs and women. Before long, a series of dangerous decisions sends the night spiraling into violence with terrifying speed.

movies.title: Raising Cain
movies.description: Carter Nix (John Lithgow) is a respected psychologist, loving husband, and devoted father who decides to take a year off to help raise his daughter. Carter's wife, Jenny (Lolita Davidovich), is pleased to have her attentive husband home – at first. When Carter shows obsessive behavior toward their daughter, Jenny becomes concerned, and to complicate matters, Jenny's old flame (Steven Bauer) reenters her life. But nothing can prepare her for the emergence of Carter's multiple personalities, and a fiendish plot to recreate the infamous experiments of his deranged father.

movies.title: Resident Evil (2026)
movies.cast: Austin Abrams, Paul Walter Hauser, Zach Cherry, Kali Reis, Johnno Wilson

movies.title: Rite Of Spring
movies.description: Oliveira’s stunning work of docufiction—predating Reis’ and Coredeiro’s collaborations by over a decade—signals a predecessor to the reverential and poetic style of filmmaking that would characterize the duo’s latter work. Oliveira, alongside Reis as assistant director, turns his camera to Curalha, a small village in western Portugal, where the local community keeps the fire of a centuries old tradition aflame by performing the Passion of Jesus yearly according to a 16th century text.

movies.title: Rosa De Areia
movies.description: Arguably the most abstract of collaborations between Reis and Cordeiro, Rosa de Areia again pays tribute to the people of Trás-os-Montes, invoking not just the area’s inhabitants but a wide variety of texts from figures like Montaigne and Kafka. Through its textured, fragmented style, Cordeiro and Reis present the north-east region of Portugal as not just a tangible space, but more conceptually as a venue for a sacred blurring between the real and the fantastical.

movies.title: Saint Joan
movies.cast: Richard Widmark, Richard Todd, Anton Walbrook, Jean Seberg
movies.description: A family of four are suddenly sealed inside their home with no way out, and must work together to survive against both their dwindling resources and the mysterious, looming threat that is keeping them trapped.

movies.director: Albert Maysles, David Maysles, Charlotte Zwerin
movies.cast: Paul Brennan, Charles McDevitt, James Baker
movies.description: A family of four are suddenly sealed inside their home with no way out, and must work together to survive against both their dwindling resources and the mysterious, looming threat that is keeping them trapped.

movies.title: Secrets & Lies
movies.cast: Marianne Jean-Baptiste, Brenda Blethyn, Timothy Spall, Phyllis Logan, Claire Rushbrook

movies.title: Seeking Haven For Mr. Rambo
movies.description: When his dog Mr. Rambo attacks his landlord in self-defense, Hassan scrambles to evade vengeful retribution targeted at his loyal canine. Traversing Cairo in search of a safehaven, Hassan faces the trials and tribulations of a restless city and confronts truths about himself in this directorial debut that premiered at the 81st Venice Film Festival.

movies.title: Sheep In The Box
movies.cast: Haruka Ayase, Daigo Yamamoto, Rimu Kuwaki
movies.description: In the near future, grieving couple Otone (Haruka Ayase) and Kensuke (Daigo Yamamoto) bring into their lives an artificial child identical to the son they lost. Japanese writer and director Hirokazu Kore-eda ( Shoplifters , Monster ) shows his signature restraint in this poignant meditation on loss, grief, and healing, screened in its world premiere at the main competition of the 2026 Cannes Film Festival in May. According to Deadline Hollywood Daily , “Kore-eda has taken the stuff of dystopian cyberpunk nightmares and turned it into an elegant, wistful fairytale.”

movies.title: Sheep in the Box
movies.cast: Haruka Ayase, Daigo Yamamoto, Rimu Kuwaki
movies.description:
Presented in Japanese with English subtitles
In the near future, Otone and Kensuke, a grieving couple who have lost their son, take into their lives a humanoid identical to their late child.

movies.title: Shorts Program 1
movies.description: This collection of shorts journeys through Black memory, spirituality, and self-discovery. Drawing from folklore, Pan-African thought, blues traditions, and experimental cinema, these works explore how the Black identity was shaped through ancestral knowledge and collective remembrance. From Zora Neale Hurston's early documentation of Southern Black life to Ben Caldwell's meditations on African consciousness, Oliver Franklin's search for Marcus Garvey, and Mike Henderson's blues cosmology, each film offers a pathway toward understanding the self in relation to history, community, and liberation. I & I: An African Allegory (1979) Dir. Ben Caldwell 32min; Digital Directed, written, and produced by Caldwell, this experimental reflection on Ayi Kwei Armah’s novel Two Thousand Seasons revolves around divisions between people, posing a unifying concept of “I and I.” In Search of Marcus Garvey (1981) Dir. Oliver Franklin 29min; Digital After a young psychologist finds critical materials concerning Marcus Garvey in a Philadelphia trash can, he embarks on a journey that unearths the lengthy history of one of Pan-Africanism’s most prominent voices. Pitchfork and the Devil (1979) Dir. Mike Henderson 16min; 16mm Perhaps best known for his rich, gestural paintings, Mike Henderson also delved into experimental filmmaking throughout the ‘70s and ‘80s, producing a series of musically-inclined short films. Pitchfork and the Devil , deemed “blues cinema” by Henderson (himself an accomplished blues guitarist), follows its titular character embroiled in trouble with the law. Fieldwork Footage (1928) Dir. Zora Neale Hurston 3min; Digital The acclaimed author of Their Eyes Were Watching God spent nearly two years, under the tutelage of anthropologist Franz Boas, documenting the folkloric customs of southern African American communities in this early work of documentary film.

movies.title: Shorts Program 2
movies.description: Through metaphorical and material rituals—in the woods, anointed with water, on the front lines, or in the downpour of rain—these short films meditate on the experience of contemporary Black womanhood. I Am Somebody (1970) Dir. Madeline Anderson With Ralph Abernathy, Coretta Scott King, Andrew Young, Claire Brown 30min; Digital In 1969, 400 poorly paid Black women went on strike to demand union recognition and a wage increase at their Charleston hospital, only to find themselves in a heated confrontation with the National Guard. Director Madeline Anderson participated in this strike, alongside Coretta Scott King, Ralph Abernathy, and Andrew Young, and documented the courage of the nurses and strikers in what is likely the first televised civil rights documentary directed by a woman of color. Rain (Nyesha) (1978) Dir. Melvonna Ballenger With Evlynne Braithwaite, Bernard Nicolas, Ijeoma Iloputaife 15min; Digital A lyrical film essay accompanied by John Coltrane’s “After the Rain,” Ballenger’s Rain (Nyesha) traces a female typist’s empowerment in a meditation on storms as not foreboding, but a chance to instead recollect. Venus of Ossabaw (2026) Dir. Allison Janae Hamilton 18min; Digital A young woman, newly-escaped from Georgia’s Ossabaw Island, navigates the swamps of Spanish East Florida on the way to a free life in Catholic St. Augustine when she discovers that, in order to survive, she must both battle and befriend a volatile landscape. Water Ritual #1: An Urban Rite of Purification (1979) Dir. Barbara McCullough With Yolanda Vidato 6min; Digital McCullough’s experimental short, made in collaboration with performer Yolanda Vidato, examines Black women’s struggle for metaphorical and material space through the symbolic act of purification.

movies.title: Silence Of The Lambs + Dog Factory
movies.description: The Silence of the Lambs (1991) Dir. Jonathan Demme With Jodie Foster, Anthony Hopkins, Scott Glenn, Ted Levine 118min; DCP When a top student at the FBI’s training academy (Foster) is tasked with hunting down a twisted serial killer, she employs the help of Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Hopkins), a psychiatrist who also happens to be a violent psychopath. Still the most recent movie to win all of the “Big Five” categories at the Academy Awards (and the only horror film to win Best Picture), Demme’s haunting psychological investigation not only lingers in the minds of its viewers, but in the cultural imaginary of American horror cinema. Alongside career-defining performances from a steadfast Foster and skin-crawling bravura depiction of psychopathy from Hopkins, a spunky little Bichon Frisé Darla (as Buffalo Bill’s companion Precious) delivers the punctuation to one of the film’s most famous lines: “It rubs the lotion on its skin, or else it gets the hose again!” Preceded by: Dog Factory (1904) Dir. Edwin S. Porter 4min; Digital This dark and surreal film from Edison’s studio features a vaudevillian trick in which sausages are turned into dogs and back again to their initial form through a “Dog Transformer” machine.

movies.title: Six: The Musical Live!
movies.description: Winner of over 35 awards, experience the best of British musical HER-story in a live capture of the must-see musical sensation, SIX the Musical. The original West End cast reunite at London’s Vaudeville Theatre in front of a sold-out audience to strut their stuff and rewrite their Tudor traumas in an unmissable cinematic recording of the show packed full of style, sass, and sensational songs. Watched by audiences of over 3.5 million, SIX the Musical has become a global theatre phenomenon since its 2017 debut at Edinburgh Festival Fringe, where it has redefined the boundaries of musical theatre. The show tells the extraordinary story of the six wives of King Henry VIII, who step out of the shadow of their infamous husband and reclaim their own narratives.

movies.title: Solaris
movies.description: Andrei Tarkovsky’s landmark of philosophical science fiction follows a psychologist dispatched to a space station outside the fictional planet of Solaris. The remaining crew has gone insane and the rules of consciousness seem to break down, leaving him to confront his innermost memories and desires—not to mention a certain ghost from his past. Made in response to Stanley Kubrick’s 2001: A Space Odyssey , Solaris draws us into its mysterious orbit as it explores not the wonders of a brave new world but the far more complex enigmas of the human mind.

movies.title: Sounder
movies.description: Ritt’s 1972 historical drama follows the Morgans, a Black sharecropper family in Louisiana, struggling in the aftermath of their patriarch’s imprisonment. Anchored by a blues soundtrack from Taj Mahal, this moving portrait of life during the Great Depression netted screenwriter Lonne Elder III an Oscar nod, becoming the first Black writer to be nominated for an Academy Award for Best Screenplay.

movies.title: Space Dogs
movies.description: The first living being sent into space (to a certain death) was Laika, a stray dog from the streets of Moscow. In Russia, a legend spread that she had returned to earth as a ghost, roaming the streets she called home alongside her tangible descendants. A sparse documentary following the lives of stray dogs in Moscow (and the humans that weave in and out of their lives), Space Dogs blurs legend with truth, capturing the humanity of non-humans and humans alike.

movies.title: Space Is The Place
movies.description: Avant-garde jazz keyboardist, composer, and bandleader Sun Ra brought his iconoclastic Afrofuturist vision—and his chaotically swinging ensemble, the Arkestra—to the big screen with this 1974 feature, co-written by Ra based on lectures he’d delivered at the University of California, Berkeley. Touching down in Oakland after years in space, the regal Ra and his cohorts revisit the leader’s early days as a strip-club pianist, meets with inner-city youth, and sets out to rescue the Black population from earthly exploitation.

movies.title: Space Jam
movies.cast: Michael Jordan, Charles Barkley, Patrick Ewing, Larry Bird, Muggsy Bogues, Wayne Knight, Bill Murray, Billy West

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.cast: Tom Holland, Zendaya, Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal, Mark Ruffalo
movies.description:
It's a BRAND NEW DAY for Peter Parker. Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn’t remember him – and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him – sparks a change in Peter he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves – a powerful villain no one can even see.

movies.title: Stalker
movies.description: One of the most immersive and rarefied experiences in the history of cinema, Andrei Tarkovsky’s Stalker embarks on a metaphysical journey through an enigmatic post-apocalyptic landscape. A hired guide—the “Stalker” of the title—leads a writer and a scientist into the heart of the Zone, the restricted site of a long-ago disaster, where the three men eventually zero in on the Room, a place rumored to fulfill one’s most deeply held desires. Adapting a science-fiction novel by Arkady and Boris Strugatsky, and making what would be his final Soviet feature, Tarkovsky created a challenging and visually stunning work, with painstaking attention to material detail and organic atmosphere. At once a religious allegory, a reflection of contemporary political anxieties, and a meditation on film itself—among many available interpretations— Stalker envelops the viewer in a multitude of possible meanings.

movies.cast: Kevin Bacon, Zachary David Cope, Kathryn Erbe, Illeana Douglas, Kevin Dunn, Conor O’Farrell

movies.title: Stormy Weather
movies.description: Rarely is a single work as richly abundant with the cultural touchstones of its era as Stormy Weather , a proverbial who’s who of the legendary African American actors, singers, musicians, and dancers synonymous with early Hollywood. Boasting an almost exclusively Black cast, Stone’s tale of an aspiring dancer courting a popular singer spotlights not only stars like Lena Horne and Bill Robinson, but also musical talent of the day—like the Nicholas Brothers, Cab Calloway, and Fats Waller. A particularly striking scene features one of the most iconic dance sequences ever put on screen: the acrobatic, precise, and ecstatic routine from the Nicholas Brothers that Fred Astaire deemed the greatest movie musical number he had ever seen.

movies.title: Summer In Japan
movies.description: Programmed by Jesse Trussell Wind rustling grass in the countryside, a sweltering heat wave ravaging sprawling Tokyo, waves crashing on the shore in Okinawa. Japanese cinema has always had a special affinity for the floating time, exuberant joy, and quiet melancholy of the summer. This series gathers together Japanese summer films spanning seven decades and many of the greatest filmmakers in the nation’s history. From postwar masters (Kurosawa, Ozu) to New Wave iconoclasts (Oshima), ‘80s upstarts (Somai, Obayashi, and Morita), ‘90s icons (Kitano, Iwai, and Aoyama), and contemporary auteurs (Hosoda and Matsumoto), behold the beauty and sadness of the summer.

movies.description: Hired to inject fresh blood into the threadbare Camp Miasma slasher-film franchise, ambitious young queer director Kris (Hannah Einbinder, of Hacks ) sets out to cast Billy Presley (Gillian Anderson), the now reclusive actress who played the “final girl” in the film that launched the series. But when the two begin to work together, the connection sparks desire, fear, and delirium. Written and directed by Jane Schoenbrun ( We’re All Going to the World's Fair , I Saw the TV Glow ), Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma opened the Un Certain Regard section at the 2026 Cannes Film Festival, where it won the Queer Palm. According to Time magazine, “Schoenbrun’s delirious third film is their most accomplished, most persuasive and most playful movie yet.”

movies.title: Terminator 2: Judgement Day 35th Anniversary
movies.description:
From visionary director James Cameron, TERMINATOR 2: JUDGEMENT DAY is the ultimate sci-fi blockbuster that redefined action forever. Arnold Schwarzenegger is back. This time, he’s the protector.
In a future ruled by machines, young John Connor holds the key to humanity’s survival. When a reprogrammed Terminator is sent back in time to protect him, a new threat emerges: the T-1000, a terrifying next-generation assassin capable of becoming anyone, anywhere. No rules. No limits. No mercy. As Sarah Connor races to stop Judgment Day before it begins, the fate of humanity hangs by a thread.
Winner of multiple Academy Awards, T2 delivers iconic action, legendary one-liners, and groundbreaking visual effects that changed cinema forever.
Back on the big screen this Judgment Day for the 35th anniversary.

movies.title: TERROR TUESDAY: DON'T TORTURE A DUCKLING
movies.description: This rural murder mystery is one of Italian cult favorite Lucio Fulci's most successfully atmospheric and intense, with more than a few shocks thrown in to goose the audience. When dead kids start popping up around a sleepy and very Catholic Italian village, the police are stymied and the locals think it's a witch (Florinda Bolkan who previously starred in Fulci's LIZARD IN A WOMAN'S SKIN), but a determined newspaperman (the handsome Tomas Milian of many Italian crime and western movies) and the daughter of a wealthy family (Barbara Bouchet). DON'T TORTURE A DUCKLING counterbalances a completely trashy, sometimes sleazy, always tasteless plot with a very artful use of setting to set mood and tone. You will feel the heat. You will not believe the ending!

movies.title: Tetsuo: The Iron Man
movies.description: A “metal fetishist” driven mad by maggots wriggling in the wounds he has created by driving metal into his flesh runs out into the night and is killed by an automobile. The driver, a businessman, buries the corpse with his girlfriend’s help, but soon begins to discover metal thorns and scabs erupting on his own body. A cult classic written, directed, edited, and produced by Shinya Tsukamoto, Tetsuo: The Iron Man earned a reputation as “one of the most pulverisingly effective sci-fi horror films of the past quarter of a century” ( Sight & Sound ) and comparisons to similarly transgressive works by Sam Raimi, David Cronenberg, and David Lynch.

He began filming Barry, Danny, Cathy, Jeff, and Jim in 1978, when they worked as guides on the Colorado River and lived together in a nude commune—resulting in his short documentary, Riverdogs (1982). movies.description: In 1977, PK, a 23-year-old Delhi street artist from a poor, ‘untouchable’ family, picked up a handful of paintbrushes and a second-hand bicycle and set off on a 6000-mile cross-continent mission - to find Lotta, the woman who had captured his heart. A love story like no other, THE CYCLE OF LOVE is an inspiring, heart-warming, epic true-life adventure about the search for self-belief and risking everything for what your heart tells you.

movies.title: The Dead Pit
movies.description: One of the few independent horror movies from the 1980s that was written, produced, and edited by a woman, THE DEAD PIT is a candy-colored zombie nightmare from writer-producer-editor Gimel Everett and director Brett Leonard (THE LAWNMOWER MAN). “Jane Doe” wakes up in an asylum with no memory of how she arrived. Soon after, an eerie green glow emanates from the basement . . . and faces start to melt. Feeling like a dreamy, camped-up soap opera as envisioned by Lucio Fulci, THE DEAD PIT is equal parts slasher, TWILIGHT ZONE, and body horror bliss.Screening the uncut restoration.

movies.title: The Fast and the Furious: 25th Anniversary
movies.description:
High stakes. Blazing speed. Heart-pounding action. A brotherhood fueled by adrenaline. Welcome to the world of underground street racing.
At the turn of the millennium, audiences across the world were introduced to a pulse-pounding, pedal-to-the-metal saga that would forever redefine the action genre... but it started on the streets.
Enter THE FAST AND THE FURIOUS, a high-octane thriller that follows undercover cop Brian O'Conner (Paul Walker) as he infiltrates the world of illegal street racing led by charismatic criminal Dominic Toretto (Vin Diesel). As loyalties are tested and relationships forged, an unforgettable partnership is born between the two rivals.
Combining the relentless speed of high-performance cars with jaw-dropping action sequences, THE FAST AND THE FURIOUS introduced a new breed of action heroes and sparked a legendary franchise. Witness the birth of a phenomenon that changed the way we experience action movies and ignited our desire for more.

movies.description:
Francis Ford Coppola's "A-side" to his gang war films and S.E. Hinton adaptations (with RUMBLE FISH being the "B-side") remains one of the defining films of an alternate-Brat Pack and '80s masculinity. Starring a veritable who’s who of ‘80s heroes and heartthrobs – Swayze! Cruise! Lowe! Estevez! – in some of the earliest roles of their careers.
A teen gang in rural Oklahoma, the Greasers are perpetually at odds with rival group the Socs. When Greasers’ Ponyboy (C. Thomas Howell) and Johnny (Ralph Macchio) get into a brawl that ends in the accidental death of a Socs member, the boys go on the run. Soon, Ponyboy and Johnny, along with the intense Dallas (Matt Dillon) and their other Greaser buddies, must contend with the consequences of their violent lives.

movies.description: One of the most critically acclaimed and highly awarded films of its year, THE PIANO arouses erotic passions and vengeful jealousies when Ada, a young mute woman (Holly Hunter), is desired by two men – her husband by an arranged marriage (Sam Neill), and the husband's darkly intense neighbor (Harvey Keitel). Violent emotions erupt, but only one man understands that Ada's heart can only be won through her beloved piano.

movies.title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
movies.cast: Masahiro Motoki, Masaki Suda, Yuriko Yoshitaka, Munetaka Aoki
movies.description: Celebrated Japanese horror director Kiyoshi Kurosawa ( Cure , Serpent’s Path ) explores a new path in this lush treatment of Honobu Yonezawa's prizewinning historical novel, detailing palace intrigue in the court of a samurai nobleman during the Azuchi era at the end of the 16th century. Turning against Oda Nobunaga, the ruthless, power-hungry warlord he previously served, Araki Murashige (Masahiro Motoki, of Departures ) is besieged by Oda’s forces and bedevilled by a series of inexplicable crimes in his household. As tension rises and loyalties fray, Murashige is forced to strategize with Kuroda Kanbei (Masaki Suda, of Kurosawa’s 2024 thriller Cloud ), a samurai envoy sent by Oda and imprisoned by Murashige, while his wife Chiyoho (Yuriko Yoshitaka) and loyalists fight to preserve order.

In this luminous directorial debut, she brings us into a day in the life of a young scout tasked with finding the perfect interiors for a television pilot. Sofía (Mimi Davila) moves in and out of other people’s intimate spaces and quotidian lives, tweaking her personality just enough to connect while struggling to find balance between her professional and personal worlds. movies.description: Nick, a former detective, retired when he married the wealthy heiress Nora, instead content to spend his days galavanting around high society. Abetted by his wife’s restless desire for adventure, the retired lawman embarks on a whodunnit quest to identify a missing inventor. Despite approaching a century since its release, The Thin Man flows with a miraculously contemporary pace and humor, replete with quick-firing ratatat from the leading couple, a jaw-dropping overconsumption of alcohol, and some truly belly laugh-inducing reaction shots from canine actor Skippy as Asta.

movies.title: The Untouchables
movies.description: Federal Agent Eliot Ness, played by a thin, wiry Kevin Costner, is on a mission to bust the most notorious gangster of our modern era, bootlegger Al Capone (Robert De Niro). The year is 1930. The place is Chicago. The good intentions meant by the Volstead Act pave a dubious road to hell – one that includes competitive organized crime, secret saloons known as speakeasies, and corruption that goes from the State St. gutter trash all the way to the very top. This windy city pastel noir runs dark with a tincture of blood and booze, featuring an Oscar-winning performance by Sean Connery as Irish-American officer Jim Malone and an unforgettable action sequence evoking BATTLESHIP POTEMKIN.

movies.title: The Wizard Of Oz
movies.description: The most seen film in cinematic history also features the most iconic dog to ever arf on the silver screen: Terry the Cairn Terrier as the ever-loyal Toto. While the prismatic story of Dorothy’s voyage through a magical world wasn’t the first Technicolor film put to screen, it surely popularized the technology with its jaw-dropping revelatory transition to vibrant color upon the Kansan’s arrival in Oz. Nominated for five Academy Awards and launching Judy Garland to international stardom, Victor Fleming’s ( Gone with the Wind ) landmark cinematic achievement lives on nearly 90 years after its release as America’s most enduring fairytale story.

movies.description: An assortment of unruly and misfit teens have all been forced to attend camp at a wildlife preserve, to commune with nature. What they don't realize is that nearby in the woods, an illicit marijuana growing operation is underway and the weed farmers have been using a pesticide which has had one very unintended side effect: turning ordinary ticks into giant, ravenous bloodsuckers...One of the quintessential creature features of the early 90s, Tony Randel's (HELLBOUND: HELLRAISER II, AMITYVILLE II: IT'S ABOUT TIME) TICKS pays loving tribute to 1950s giant monster movies, updating the formula by adding copious amounts of slime and heavily increased bloodshed. Starring Seth Green (AUSTIN POWERS), Alfonso Ribeiro (TV's FRESH PRINCE OF BEL AIR), Rosalind Allen (TV's SEINFELD) and a very memorable appearance from Clint Howard (ICE CREAM MAN), TICKS is newly remastered in 4K. (Vinegar Syndrome)

movies.cast: Dominic Sessa, Emilia Jones, Leo Woodall, Antonio Banderas, Stavros Halkias
movies.description: When a writing fellowship falls through, 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain (Dominic Sessa, THE HOLDOVERS) heads to Cape Cod to chase a college girl instead. What he finds is a dish pit, a hammock to sleep in, and the glorious madness of a Provincetown seafood kitchen. One of our favorite filmmakers, Matt Johnson (NIRVANNA THE BAND THE SHOW THE MOVIE, BLACKBERRY), captures the summer Bourdain accidentally discovered the calling that would change his life forever. Antonio Banderas gives one of the best performances of his career, trading swagger for warmth in a role that's funny, patient, and deeply felt.

movies.description: A pioneering docudrama and the first feature in António Reis and Mararida Corederio’s trilogy, Trás-os-Montes paints a vivid portrait of the extraordinary titular region of north-east Portugal. Blurring the past, present, and future through a series of palpable vignettes, French filmmaker and anthropologist Jean Rouch said that the work “reveals a new cinematographic language.”

movies.title: Umberto D.
movies.description: This neorealist masterpiece by Vittorio De Sica follows an elderly pensioner as he strives to make ends meet during Italy’s postwar economic recovery. Alone except for his dog, Flike, Umberto struggles to maintain his dignity in a city where human kindness seems to have been swallowed up by the forces of modernization. His simple quest to satisfy his basic needs—food, shelter, companionship—makes for one of the most heartbreaking stories ever filmed, and an essential classic of world cinema.

movies.title: We're All Going to the World's Fair
movies.description:
This thought-provoking debut horror from writer/director Jane Schoenbrun just might be the most honest portrayal of teenage isolation in the internet age ever put to film. WE’RE ALL GOING TO THE WORLD’S FAIR follows Casey (Anna Cobb) as she seeks community and validation in the World’s Fair Challenge – a twisted online role-playing horror game. Soon, the game begins to blend the lines between her online and offline life in horrifying and heartbreaking ways.
Schoenbrun takes this creepypasta concept and elevates it to dizzying heights, delivering a thoughtful, authentic, and unsettling look at a young life lived entirely online. Cobb carries the film on her young shoulders as essentially the only cast member, at least IRL. WE’RE ALL GOING TO THE WORLD’S FAIR is jarring, mesmerizing, and casts an empathetic light on an entire generation just looking for connection.

movies.title: Welcome Ii The Terrordome
movies.description: New restoration! Ngozi Onwurah’s radically ahead-of-its-time Afrofuturist vision Welcome II the Terrordome made history as the first theatrically distributed British feature directed by a Black woman. Nevertheless, it was largely dismissed upon its release by critics unable to see the urgency in its evocation of a gritty dystopia in which Black people have been relegated to a slum called the Terrordome, where simmering racial tension threatens to boil over in the wake of a young boy’s death. But over 30 years later, Onwurah’s fusion of political commentary and genre spectacle looks positively prescient, and her ability to build an entire cosmology that connects the history of slavery to present-day police brutality is nothing less than visionary. Q&As with Ngozi Onwurah following the 7pm screenings on Friday, July 31 and Saturday, August 1.

movies.title: Wendy And Lucy
movies.description: From the modern master of American slow cinema, Wendy and Lucy is a tragic (and poignant) portrait of an isolated woman and the lengths she’ll go for her only companion. Penniless and unhoused, Wendy (Williams) is traveling to Alaska when she loses her dog (played by Reichhardt’s own pup Lucy), sending her on a mission to reunite with her sole confidant. Minimal and heart-wrenching, Wendy and Lucy is a stunning exploration of loneliness, and a masterclass display of Reichhardt's meticulous vision.

movies.title: Wet Hot American Summer: 25th Anniversary
movies.description:
Remember those kids who were too cool for school? Those kids are now your camp counselors.
David Wain and company (including members of MTV's The State, the Upright Citizens Brigade, SNL, and a pre-famed Bradley Cooper) make idiosyncratic, over-the-top. strangely touching comedy. These character creations are unlike anything you've ever seen AND people you can relate to. There's young love, steamy sessions in the shed, talking cans, and everybody's favorite activity...going to town!
So relive this unbelievably watchable, funny, original movie. It doesn't give one single f*ck...and that's the best part.

movies.title: What Ever Happened to Baby Jane? (1962)
movies.description:
Named by the American Film Institute as one of the 50 Best Villains of American Cinema, Bette Davis’ portrayal of bitter former child star “Baby Jane” Hudson stands as one of the most deliciously wicked onscreen performances of all time.
Resentful of her sister Blanche’s (Joan Crawford) more successful acting career, Baby Jane has the opportunity to exact her revenge when a wheelchair-bound Blanche becomes dependent on her younger sister for care. With gripping suspense, surprising humor, and no small amount of camp, WHAT EVER HAPPENED TO BABY JANE? is one of American cinema’s greatest psychological thrillers.

movies.title: When The Levees Broke: A Requiem In Four Acts
movies.description: Released a year after Hurricane Katrina, When the Levees Broke comprises a series of interviews and news footage excerpts recounting the devastation of New Orleans and the critical mishandling of its aftermath. In his third documentary, Lee gives voice to survivors in a mournful and powerful work of meticulous documentation, redirecting the legendary director’s keen filmic eye towards a true modern tragedy, and the beacons of hope that lay in its wake.

movies.title: Where is the Friend's House?
movies.description:
Presented in Persian with English subtitles
The first film in Abbas Kiarostami’s sublime, interlacing trilogy of films set in the northern Iranian village of Koker takes a premise of fable-like simplicity – a boy searches for the home of his classmate whose school notebook he has accidentally taken – and transforms it into a miraculous, child’s-eye adventure of the everyday. As our young hero zigzags determinedly across two towns, aided (and sometimes misdirected) by those he encounters, his quest becomes both a revealing portrait of Iranian society in all its richness and complexity and a touching parable about the meaning of personal responsibility. Shot through with all the wonder, beauty, tension, and mystery one day can contain, WHERE IS THE FRIEND'S HOUSE? established Kiarostami’s reputation as one of cinema’s most sensitive and profound humanists. (Janus)
